purpose: Define reusable objectives, stakes, outcome states and victory conditions that support full success, partial success, fail-forward, competing priorities, clocks and non-defeat resolutions without creating live objective truth or predicting outcomes.
controlling_rule: A GCL-05 record describes how success, compromise, failure continuation, stakes and timing can be framed. It does not assert that a live objective exists, that a character has succeeded or failed, that an outcome is canonical, or that any particular method is required.

nonauthorization: does not create or mutate Campaign/Scene/Encounter objective truth
does not declare a canonical or predicted outcome
does not guarantee success, failure, recovery, fairness, balance or winnability
does not award rewards or mutate aftermath/world state
does not tune difficulty or collapse objective pressure into a scalar
does not prescribe one required solution or mandatory player choice

stable_id_rule: objective_template_id must begin with the manifest-declared family prefix and remain stable across wording-only revisions.
parameterization_rule: All {slot_id} placeholders appearing anywhere in the compact objective record must be declared in slot_ids and come from the controlled slot vocabulary.

slot_vocabulary.semantic_role: person, object, place, process, state or bounded goal at issue
person/group/object whose safety, access or continued function may matter
explicit deadline, countdown, schedule, depletion or event boundary
clue, trace, record, testimony or observable support
group/side/coalition later bound by the consumer
competing or obstructing actor/group/process, not automatically hostile
decision maker, gatekeeper, office or institution
path, passage, itinerary or movement option
scarce, carried, consumed, contested or useful asset
barrier, constraint, access problem or bounded obstruction supplied by the owning context
device, mechanism, structure, vehicle or technical object
settlement, crew, household, organization or social group
trust, obligation, rivalry, debt or social bond supplied by owning context
person/source able to provide partial information

outcome_openness.rule: A reusable objective exposes criteria and possible states while leaving actual resolution to play and owning-domain adjudication.

f012_boundary: MV-IA-F012 owns real Encounter objective bindings, validation, analysis, approval and attachment. GCL-05 only supplies reusable objective structures.
f005_boundary: MV-IA-F005 and related Campaign/Scene/Session authorities own live Scene/Campaign state and accepted history.
gcl07_boundary: Objective/time pressure may be described but not tuned or scored here; GCL-07 owns later uncertainty-aware difficulty shaping.
gcl14_boundary: GCL-14 owns rewards, aftermath and consequence libraries; GCL-05 may name stakes but does not award or mutate consequences.
composition_rule: GCL-05 can compose with GCL-02 hooks, GCL-03 situations, GCL-04 encounter archetypes and later GCL-06/07/09/10/14 structures. Composed output remains proposal material until accepted by the owning domain.
